research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Armed-forces table suspension
verified_claims: The first-receptions table for former armed-services members was paused indefinitely after a data-quality investigation.
limitations: Suspended data must not be promoted or used to infer outcomes.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual releases
verified_claims: There were 56,923 releases from custody in 2025: 56,581 from determinate sentences and 342 from indeterminate sentences.
limitations: Release totals are national justice-system flows, not neighbourhood safety measures.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Determinate releases trend
verified_claims: Determinate-sentence releases in 2025 were virtually unchanged from 2024 and remained below the 2015 to 2019 average.
limitations: Trend comparisons do not provide event or parcel geography.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Short-sentence releases
verified_claims: Releases from determinate sentences over six months and under 12 months increased by 35% to 8,491 in 2025.
limitations: The change is associated with sentencing policy and cannot be attributed to a property.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Indeterminate releases
verified_claims: There were 342 releases from indeterminate sentences in 2025, 23% fewer than in 2024.
limitations: The figure is a national flow and not a local safety signal.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Mean sentence and time served
verified_claims: For determinate releases in 2025, mean sentence length was 27.6 months and mean time served was 14.3 months.
limitations: Averages conceal variation and cannot be applied to individuals or locations.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Median sentence and time served
verified_claims: For determinate releases in 2025, median sentence length was 14.0 months and median time served was 6.0 months.
limitations: Medians are aggregate descriptors and not parcel-level inputs.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual HDC releases
verified_claims: There were 11,796 Home Detention Curfew releases in 2025, 16% more than in 2024.
limitations: HDC releases reflect eligibility and policy changes, not local incident risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: HDC long-sentence share
verified_claims: Prisoners serving determinate sentences of four years or more accounted for 33% of HDC releases in 2025, compared with 23% in 2024.
limitations: The share is a release-policy measure and not spatial evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: HDC recall rate
verified_claims: Of offenders released on HDC in 2024, 21% were recalled, compared with 19% in the previous year.
limitations: The latest complete HDC recall cohort lags the release period and cannot be used for parcel scoring.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual ROTL incidences
verified_claims: There were 383,197 releases-on-temporary-licence incidences in 2025, 5% fewer than in 2024.
limitations: ROTL incidences may include repeated events for the same person and have no parcel geography.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: People receiving ROTL
verified_claims: The number of individuals receiving temporary licence fell by 7% to 7,154 in 2025.
limitations: The person count is national and cannot indicate local risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual prisoner transfers
verified_claims: Prisoner-transfer incidences increased by 4% to 95,247, while people receiving at least one transfer increased by 3% to 66,471.
limitations: Transfers reflect operational movement and must not be interpreted as local crime events.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly releases
verified_claims: There were 14,643 releases in October to December 2025: 14,555 determinate and 88 indeterminate.
limitations: The quarterly release count is not local public-safety evidence.
